boundary_evidence: PARTIAL RUN, 49 of 61. tu_map calls 0x20ea280..0x20ede18 one contiguous linker run of 61 function(s) (build/tu_map.json, tools/tu_map.py). This TU licenses 0x020eac38..0x020ede18, 49 function(s), ROM ordinals 12..60. Of the other 12, 11 keep their own shards and their own delinks.txt entries; the 12th is the sourceless hole in EDGE 1 below, which has neither.

EDGE 1 -- a sourceless hole splits the run, and it is now the ONLY edge. ROM ordinal 11, func_ov006_020ea914 (0x020ea914, size 0x324), has no source anywhere in the tree: it is a banked near-miss (config/match_attempts.jsonl, best 113 divergences, size-exact but mis-coloured) and carries no entry in config/arm9/overlays/ov006/delinks.txt at all -- the cartridge's own bytes cover that range. It sits in the MIDDLE of the run, and no delink block and no TU manifest anywhere in this tree expresses a .text claim with a hole in it (both checked tree-wide: zero of each carries two .text runs). So the run can only be licensed as one of its two contiguous sides; ordinals 0..10 (0x020ea280..0x020ea914, 11 functions, including the destructor pair) are the smaller side and stay out.

EDGE 2 IS GONE -- the two contradicting file-global pragmas were dissolved, not worked around. The previous promotion of this class took only ordinals 13..34 (22 functions) because four members reproduce only with `#pragma opt_strength_reduction off` (func_ov006_020eac38, func_ov006_020ec458, func_ov006_020ec93c, func_ov006_020ec9c0) and three only with it on (func_ov006_020ebf20, func_ov006_020ec2bc, func_ov006_020ecba4), while _ZN15dScMgHanachan_c6RenderEv wants `#pragma opt_common_subs off`, which costs five other members when set file-wide. Whole-side scores measured then: SR off / OCS on = 44/49, SR on / OCS on = 42/49, SR off / OCS off = 40/49, and bracketing SR `off ... on` positionally was byte-identical to omitting it. All of that is true only while codegen is DEFERRED. With `#pragma defer_codegen off` at the top of the TU, mwccarm 2004/b56 generates each function at parse time and both pragmas bind POSITIONALLY: the four SR-off members carry their own `#pragma push / opt_strength_reduction off / #pragma pop` bracket, Render carries an opt_common_subs bracket, and all 49 reproduce in one compile. Measured on this TU, not inferred from a sibling.

EDGE 2 addendum -- `defer_codegen off` also flips emission order, and the two effects are one edit. With codegen deferred mwccarm lays .text down in the REVERSE of source order; generating at parse time lays it down in source order. This file is therefore written lowest-ROM-address FIRST, the opposite of the 22-function version. Measured both ways on the identical member set: source ROM-descending + defer_codegen off gives 22/22 MATCH but `21 ordinal pair(s) NOT in ROM order`; source ROM-ascending + defer_codegen off gives 22/22 MATCH and `all 22 in the expected ROM-ascending section order`. Flipping either alone fails the `linkcheck [4b/8]` emission-order refusal.

Three byte-diffs that surfaced only in the merge, all fixed at the source and none of them pragma-related. (a) func_ov006_020ec4dc, func_ov006_020ecba4 and func_ov006_020ec9c0 each assign a two-int pair whole-struct; the legacy files were C and block-moved it (ldr/ldr/str/str) where C++ scalarizes (ldr/str/ldr/str), so those three copies go through the array-spelled `struct Words2`. (b) _ZN15dScMgHanachan_c13OnYoshiTryEatEi's read-modify-write of +0xbc let mwcc CSE the field address into its own register (add r2,r4,#0xbc), one word longer than the cartridge's re-issued ldr r1,[r4,#0xbc]; a `const` on the read side defeats the CSE. Seven source forms were tried and six of them match; `x += 1` is the one that does not.

NOT a destructor-order refusal. The ROM orders this class D1 (0x020ea280) BELOW D0 (0x020ea2c8), which is the reproducible direction (inline-in-class => D1 then D0) and would have promoted whole; the pair is out only because it lies on the far side of the sourceless hole. Consequently this TU does not own the class's key function -- the first declared virtual is the out-of-line ~dScMgHanachan_c() -- so it emits no _ZTV/_ZTI/_ZTS, needs no compiler_only_output block (verify reports zero unlicensed symbols), and needed no header edit: include/dScMgHanachan_c.h keeps the out-of-line destructor declaration that the two still-enrolled destructor shards require.
